items.source: Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
items.translation: 已弃用，即将移除：此 API 元素将在未来版本中移除。

items.source: Set the Spring ApplicationContext in order to autowire Jackson handlers (JsonSerializer, JsonDeserializer, KeyDeserializer, TypeResolverBuilder and TypeIdResolver).
items.translation: 设置 Spring ApplicationContext 以自动注入 Jackson 处理器（JsonSerializer、JsonDeserializer、KeyDeserializer、TypeResolverBuilder 和 TypeIdResolver）。

items.source: Variant of Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.modules(Module...) with a Consumer for full control over the underlying list of modules.
items.translation: `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.modules(Module...)` 的变体，使用一个 `Consumer` 来完全控制底层模块列表。

items.source: Variant of Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.modules(Module...) with a List.
items.translation: `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.modules(Module...)` 的变体，使用 `List。

items.source: Variant of Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.modulesToInstall(Module...) with a Consumer for full control over the underlying list of modules.
items.translation: `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.modulesToInstall(Module...)` 的变体，使用 Consumer 以完全控制底层模块列表。

items.source: Alternative to Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.annotationIntrospector(AnnotationIntrospector) that allows combining with rather than replacing the currently set introspector, for example, via AnnotationIntrospector.pair(AnnotationIntrospector, AnnotationIntrospector).
items.translation: 替代 `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder.annotationIntrospector(AnnotationIntrospector)` 的方法，它允许组合而非替换当前设置的 introspector，例如通过 `AnnotationIntrospector.pair(AnnotationIntrospector, AnnotationIntrospector)`。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a CBOR data format ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建一个 CBOR 数据格式的ObjectMapper实例。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a regular JSON ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建常规的 JSONObjectMapper 实例。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a Smile data format ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建一个 Smile 数据格式的ObjectMapper实例。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build an XmlMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建一个XmlMapper实例。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a YAML data format ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以构建一个YAML数据格式的ObjectMapper实例。

items.source: Override the default Locale to use for formatting.
items.translation: 覆盖用于格式化的默认 Locale。

items.source: Override the default TimeZone to use for formatting.
items.translation: 覆盖用于格式化的默认 TimeZone。

items.source: Add mix-in annotations to use for augmenting specified class or interface.
items.translation: 添加混入注解，用于增强指定的类或接口。

items.source: Set a custom inclusion strategy for serialization.
items.translation: 为序列化设置自定义包含策略。

items.source: Uses of Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder in org.springframework.http.converter.json
items.translation: `Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder` 在 `org.springframework.http.converter.json` 包中的用法

items.source: Customize the construction of Jackson handlers (JsonSerializer, JsonDeserializer, KeyDeserializer, TypeResolverBuilder and TypeIdResolver).
items.translation: 自定义 Jackson 处理程序（`JsonSerializer`、`JsonDeserializer`、`KeyDeserializer`、`TypeResolverBuilder` 和 `TypeIdResolver`）的构建。

items.source: Shortcut for MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_SETTERS/ MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_GETTERS/MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_IS_GETTERS options.
items.translation: `MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_SETTERS`/`MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_GETTERS`/`MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_IS_GETTERS` 选项的快捷方式。

items.source: If set to true, an XmlMapper will be created using its default constructor.
items.translation: 如果设置为 `true`，将使用其默认构造函数创建 `XmlMapper`。

items.source: Define the format for date/time with the given DateFormat.
items.translation: 使用给定的 `DateFormat` 定义日期/时间格式。

items.source: Define the JsonFactory to be used to create the ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 定义用于创建 ObjectMapper 实例的 JsonFactory。

items.source: Specify a PropertyNamingStrategy to configure the ObjectMapper with.
items.translation: 指定一个 `PropertyNamingStrategy` 来配置 `ObjectMapper`。

items.source: Define the date/time format with a SimpleDateFormat.
items.translation: 使用 `SimpleDateFormat` 定义日期/时间格式。

items.source: Set an AnnotationIntrospector for both serialization and deserialization.
items.translation: 为序列化和反序列化都设置一个AnnotationIntrospector。

items.source: Shortcut for MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_FIELDS option.
items.translation: MapperFeature.AUTO_DETECT_FIELDS 选项的快捷方式。

items.source: Specify a TypeResolverBuilder to use for Jackson's default typing.
items.translation: 指定一个用于 Jackson 默认类型的 `TypeResolverBuilder`。

items.source: Define if a wrapper will be used for indexed (List, array) properties or not by default (only applies to XmlMapper).
items.translation: 通过默认设置定义是否将为索引属性（List、数组）使用包装器（仅适用于XmlMapper）。

items.source: Shortcut for MapperFeature.DEFAULT_VIEW_INCLUSION option.
items.translation: MapperFeature.DEFAULT_VIEW_INCLUSION 选项的快捷方式。

items.source: Shortcut for SerializationFeature.FAIL_ON_EMPTY_BEANS option.
items.translation: SerializationFeature.FAIL_ON_EMPTY_BEANS 选项的快捷方式。

items.source: Shortcut for DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES option.
items.translation: DeserializationFeature.FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES 选项的快捷方式。

items.source: Set the global filters to use in order to support @JsonFilter annotated POJO.
items.translation: 设置全局过滤器以支持带有@JsonFilter注解的 POJO。

items.source: Shortcut for SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT option.
items.translation: SerializationFeature.INDENT_OUTPUT 选项的快捷方式。

items.source: Specify the modules to be registered with the ObjectMapper.
items.translation: 指定要使用 `ObjectMapper` 注册的模块。

items.source: Specify one or more modules to be registered with the ObjectMapper.
items.translation: 指定一个或多个要注册到 `ObjectMapper` 的模块。

items.source: Specify one or more modules by class to be registered with the ObjectMapper.
items.translation: 指定一个或多个模块类以注册到 `ObjectMapper`。

items.source: An option to apply additional customizations directly to the ObjectMapper instances at the end, after all other config properties of the builder have been applied.
items.translation: 在应用构建器的所有其他配置属性后，在末尾直接对 `ObjectMapper` 实例应用额外自定义的选项。

items.source: Provides HttpMessageConverter implementations for handling JSON.
items.translation: 提供用于处理 JSON 的 HttpMessageConverter 实现。

items.source: Configure a custom deserializer for the given type.
items.translation: 为给定类型配置自定义反序列化器。

items.source: Configure custom deserializers.
items.translation: 配置自定义反序列化器。

items.source: Configure custom deserializers for the given types.
items.translation: 为给定类型配置自定义反序列化器。

items.source: Specify features to disable.
items.translation: 指定要禁用的功能。

items.source: Specify features to enable.
items.translation: 指定要启用的功能。

items.source:
Set whether to let Jackson find available modules via the JDK ServiceLoader,
based on META-INF metadata in the classpath.
items.translation: 设置是否让 Jackson 通过类路径中的 META-INF 元数据，利用 JDK ServiceLoader 查找可用的模块。

items.source: Set the ClassLoader to use for loading Jackson extension modules.
items.translation: 设置用于加载 Jackson 扩展模块的 ClassLoader。

items.source: Configure a custom serializer for the given type.
items.translation: 为给定类型配置自定义序列化器。

items.source: Configure custom serializers.
items.translation: 配置自定义序列化器。

items.source: Configure custom serializers for the given types.
items.translation: 为给定类型配置自定义序列化器。

items.source: Specify visibility to limit what kind of properties are auto-detected.
items.translation: 指定可见性以限制自动检测的属性类型。
